race.comment: BELIEVE AGAIN (13) is a well-bred gelding, being a half-brother to Group winner Alsephina. Pike has been with him all the way through, trialling him on all three occasions. He looks to have plenty of ability and he's found a suitable race on debut. VAMPI QUEEN (10) trialled well coming into the fresh effort, running on from midfield at Bunbury over 1400m. CJP hops back on board and she should be better for the fresh effort. Can improve on that effort and make her presence felt. BOUTIQUE BELLE (9) won a trial coming into this and jumped favourite on resumption, missing by 0.7L. Drawn wider this time, but out to 1400m is a bonus and Tsang's claim means she gets in lightly at the weights. Can put her best foot forward. JUST YES (5) can feature on resumption with Chris Parnham booked. ENERGETIC (1) won't be far away on recent efforts.
